## Description

A ~70 µm hypotrich that walks on its cirri and grazes bacteria and small algae. With the kairomone of
its predator *Lembadion* in the water, within a cell cycle it develops lateral wings: it becomes ~40 %
wider (without more cytoplasm) and *Lembadion* can no longer swallow it. Without the signal it returns
to the normal form.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 3 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

An [induced morph](../../mechanics/chemical-signals.md#m4--induced-morph) triggered by the *Lembadion* signal; one
or two *Lembadion* per drop are enough. Morph width, threshold and time estimated.
